title: Euro Step Finishing
description: Learn the two-step directional change that wrong-foots shot blockers, then finish with touch off either hand.
goal: Master the euro step gather and directional change to finish around shot blockers without charging.
setup: Place one cone at the top of the key as your starting drive point and one cone near the elbow as the 'defender'.
Start each rep dribbling at the defender cone from the top.
A chair or pad at the rim can simulate a shot blocker.

instructions.title: Drive at the defender cone
instructions.detail: Attack the cone at the elbow with speed, as if a help defender is sliding over.

instructions.title: Pick up and step one
instructions.detail: Gather the ball and take a long first step to one side of the cone — sell it with your shoulders.

instructions.title: Step two across
instructions.detail: Push off and step across to the opposite side of the cone, changing direction sharply while keeping the ball protected.

instructions.title: Finish off the glass
instructions.detail: Finish with the outside hand off the backboard — right side finishes with the right hand, left side with the left.

instructions.title: Alternate both directions
instructions.detail: Do 5 euro steps going right-to-left and 5 going left-to-right, then 5 where you choose the direction reactively.

coachingPoints: The first step must be long and convincing — a short step doesn't move the defender.
Keep the ball tight to your body through both steps; a loose ball gets poked away.
Stay low and balanced — the euro step is a change of direction, not a leap.
Land and finish under control; don't drift under the basket.
commonMistakes: Taking a third step — gather cleanly and count your two steps; extra steps are travels in games.
Jumping sideways instead of stepping — the move works through footwork and deception, not athleticism.
progression: Add a live defender at the cone who commits to one side, add a shot-blocker pad at the rim, or chain the euro into a reverse finish.
regression: Walk through the footwork without a ball first, do it from a standstill gather, or remove the defender cone.
gameApplication: Help defenders meet you at the rim in every game — the euro step is the primary tool for finishing around them without forcing contact.
